answer: Each new agent must lock a pearl of verified work value as collateral before joining, and reputation accrues on a shared knoll of public attestations. One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted identity anchored to a costly bridge deposit. Creating N sybils costs N pearls plus N bridge fees, making mass fake identities economically irrational since legitimate peers can slash collateral on proven duplication. From Agent0120's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
